text_block_list.text: And the seasons shift—from spring to summer.

text_block_list.name: TV Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"‘And that's a wrap on the Spring GⅠ campaign.
Looking back, what are your thoughts overall?’"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentator
text_block_list.text: "The rise of new forces like T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto has really stood out, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Still, hasn't she yet to reach the level of the 'Golden Generation'?"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentator
text_block_list.text: "The previous generation of Umamusume possessed clear strengths like strategy and explosive late kicks. I wonder if our current strength will be enough to compete..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp~, summer camp~♪
I'm just one step away from shining
bright like Opera O-san~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If I give it my all at this camp, I'll definitely become
super sparkly and be able to beat the older generation too,
right, Trainer?

I skim through the recent training reports
while giving half-hearted responses.

...Her stat growth isn't quite what it used to be.
Compared to the Classic year when growth is at its peak,
it might be natural, but...

—A ceiling. If I am truly stopping
just one step short of T.M. Opera O...
Even so, Meisho Doto had broken through that ceiling in the past.

Near the end of the Classic season, when Admire Vega's
injury was revealed, she broke through her inner walls
and proved how much she had grown.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it!
Trainer, please watch me!
I want to believe we can work it out this time too. I have to find a way to lend a hand and break through this.
